questions.question:
Choose the option that is the correct direct form of the sentence.

Shubham said that his father was playing cricket with him.

options.text: Shubham said, “My father was playing cricket with me.”
Shubham said, “My father is playing cricket with me.”
Shubham said, “My father played cricket with me.”
Shubham said, “My father had played cricket with me.”

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **The original sentence** states that Shubham said that his father** "was"** playing cricket with him.
 
• **When we convert** direct speech to indirect speech, we generally need to shift the verb tense back one step.
 
• However, in this case, option 2** maintains the present tense of the verb** "is" because it accurately reflects the original sentence's meaning.

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *'Shubham said, “My father is playing cricket with me.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1)** "Shubham said, 'My father was playing cricket with me.'" changes the verb tense to **past tense ("was playing"), **which does not align with the reported speech. The original sentence indicates that the father is currently playing cricket, so the present tense should be maintained.
 
• **Option 3)** "Shubham said, 'My father played cricket with me.'" changes the verb tense to **past tense ("played"),** which again does not accurately convey the present ongoing action of the father playing cricket.
 
• **Option 4)** "Shubham said, 'My father had played cricket with me.'" uses the **past perfect tense ("had played"),** which suggests an action completed before a past point of reference. However, there is no specific past point of reference mentioned in the original sentence, so the past perfect tense is not necessary.

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order. The immediate context of the Dunkirk evacuation was Germany’s invasion of the Low Countries and northern France in May 1940.

• The** correct order** of the jumbled sentences is** option 4) RPQS.**
 
• **R.** On May 10 the German blitzkrieg attack on the Netherlands began with the capture by parachutists of key bridges deep within the country, with the aim of opening the way for mobile ground forces.
 
• **P. **The Dutch defenders fell back westward, and by noon on May 12 German tanks were on the outskirts of Rotterdam.
 
• **Q.** Queen Wilhelmina and her government left the country for England on May 13, and the next day the Dutch army surrendered to the Germans.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

AWS offers various storage services that can ______ data for your website.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** option 4) i.e. 'store'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence states** that AWS (Amazon Web Services) offers various storage services that can** "store"** data for your website.
 
• **"Store" **is the appropriate verb in this context, as it means to keep or hold something in a particular place or container.
 
• **In the context** of AWS storage services, they provide options for storing data in different ways, such as object storage, block storage, and file storage.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *AWS offers various storage services that can **store** data for your website. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain** why the other options are incorrect**:

 
 
• **"Stack"** means to arrange objects in a neat and orderly pile or stack. While AWS storage services may use underlying technologies that involve stacking physical devices, the verb "stack" does not convey the intended meaning of storing data for a website.
 
• **"Pour"** means to cause a liquid or other substance to flow rapidly and in large quantities. It does not match the context of storing data for a website, which involves organizing and saving digital information rather than pouring a substance.
 
• **"Barge"** means to intrude or push one's way forcefully. It does not relate to the concept of storing data and is not appropriate in this context.

The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Tomato'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence mentions** that it was common for the poor of the area around Naples to add something to their yeast-based flatbread, which led to the beginning of pizza.
 
• The word **"tomato"** is the correct answer because it was the ingredient that was commonly added to the flatbread.
 
• The **use of tomato** as a topping on pizza is a key factor in its evolution and has become an integral part of traditional pizza recipes.
 
• Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *It was common for the poor of the area around Naples to add **tomato** to their yeast-based flat bread, and so the pizza began.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Option 2) "potato"** is not historically associated with the early development of pizza. While potatoes have their culinary uses, they are not typically used as a topping for traditional pizza.

**Option 3) "onion"** is also not the ingredient commonly added to the flatbread in the context of pizza's origin.

**Option 4) "herb" **is a more general term and does not specifically refer to the significant ingredient that led to the evolution of pizza.
